member.returns: True if the member should be automatically mapped to the underlying database, otherwise false.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.DocumentManagement.DAL.NHibernate.Mappings.MappingConfiguration.AbstractClassIsLayerSupertype(System.Type)
member.summary: Returns whether a specified abstract type is a type of interest from an auto-mapping standpoint. We care about any entity types, i.e. anything derived from either the or types.

member.returns: True if the specified type is an entity type of interest, otherwise false.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.DocumentManagement.DAL.NHibernate.Mappings.MappingConfiguration.IsId(FluentNHibernate.Member)
